items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know a trombone player by the name of Jimmy Cleveland? [INTERVIEWER] No, no.

ctx.x: I haven't heard anybody with the style of Benny Morton, because most of the time when he plays, he growls, but not like Tricky Sam growled. That was part of his tone; that's the way he played. But Jay Jay Johnson, that was nothing but just technician, everything is going-going-going-going, and you don't know what's happening. I didn't; maybe they did.
Did you know a trombone player by the name of Jimmy Cleveland?
